resources.string: Welcome to simple drawing
Welcome to simple notes
New: ruler, template and moving
Hold to move, moving the background, the ruler, shape templates and CMYK saving.
New: pages, ruler and PDF
The page scrubber, diagrams with or without a background, page numbers, header and footer, the ruler, PDF and the save location.
New: characters and backgrounds
Ready-made characters and backgrounds, page numbers, PDF and CBZ, the ruler and hold to move.
Get to know simple drawing
Brush, shapes, paint, moving, text boxes, background, ruler and saving.
Get to know simple notes
Text, pen, diagrams, ruler, moving, pages and PDF.
What\'s new with Painty
The ruler, moving pictures and the 50-level Drawing Quest.
Hold to move
Keep your finger still on an element for 5 seconds: when the ring fills, the element is selected and Move turns on; drag without lifting your finger. It works in every drawing type.
Move the background
After choosing a picture with the Background button, tap Move / resize: drag the picture, and resize it with two fingers or by its corners.
Ruler
Tap the Ruler button in the Draw row. Rotate it with the handle at one end and lengthen it with the other; drag the body to move it. The angle and length are shown in the bar at the bottom.
Type, unit and scale

Use the buttons next to the ruler to pick its type: straight ruler, protractor, set square, compass, ellipse template or French curve. The button at the other end changes the unit (mm, cm, inch, pixel) and the scale (1:1, 1:2, 1:5…); Finish is there too.
Draw along the edge
Draw close to the ruler\'s edge: the line follows the edge and comes out perfectly straight. When you are done, tap Finish.
Shape template
Tap the Shape template button in the Draw row: tap a shape on the canvas or pick one From library. Copy the shape by drawing close to the template\'s edge. We\'re drawing a star.
Save: CMYK and location
In the Save as image window you can pick the CMYK color mode for printing (TIFF or PDF). Use Choose location to set the file\'s folder; your choice is remembered.
Ready-made characters
Add → Characters: choose a style and theme, then tap a character. Pick a variant from the Expressions, Poses, Action or Everyday groups and it is added to the page.
Location background
Add → Location background: Manga and Comic tabs with subcategories. Tap a background, then drop it on a panel and it fits that panel. Drop it outside the panels or tap Whole page to cover the page.
Page numbers, header and footer
⋮ → Page settings: add a number, a header and a footer to every page. They also appear in image, PDF and CBZ exports.
PDF and CBZ
Save your comic as a PDF or CBZ from the ⋮ menu. In a CBZ every page is a separate image and it opens in comic readers. You can also pick the folder while saving.
PDF and save location
⋮ → Save as PDF: all pages in one file. You can pick a CMYK PDF for printing and set the folder with Choose location.
Page scrubber
Long-press the page bar at the bottom: it grows larger; slide your finger left and right to fly through the pages, and the page opens when you let go.
Diagrams with or without a background
When adding a diagram, use the Background option to make its boxes filled or transparent; a transparent diagram doesn\'t hide the paper\'s lines. We add one of each.
Single-stroke suggestion
Even a single stroke gets a suggestion balloon if it is big enough. Tap the balloon and the stroke turns clean. We\'re drawing a big circle.
Single-stroke suggestion: tap it and the stroke becomes clean.
First select the element you want to paint, then fill its inside with the paint bucket; with nothing selected it paints the paper. Solid color or gradient. We give the sky a sunset gradient.
Drag the selection or nudge it by 1–10 pixels with the arrow buttons; holding an element for 5 seconds also turns on Move. We lower the sun toward the space behind the mountains.
Line fixing, template recognition (4+ elements close together), single-stroke suggestions and AI settings.
Draw several lines and lift the pen: each line becomes clean and nearby ends join up. We\'re drawing the moon with two arcs.
Turning handwriting into text, fixing lines together and single-stroke suggestions.
Comic-specific recognition (speech balloon, facial expressions), fixing lines together and single-stroke suggestions.
Add, duplicate and delete pages and switch between them with the bar at the bottom; long-press the bar to open the page scrubber. You can save your notes as a PDF from the ⋮ menu.
In Comic mode, templates, speech balloons, ready-made characters, effects and speed lines are in this menu.
Brush
Draw freely with the brush. You pick the color and thickness with the brush button.
Shapes
Add ready-made shapes with the shape button. We\'re putting in a house and a sun.
Paint
Choose Paint, pick a color and tap inside a shape: that area gets painted.
Select and Move
The 5th button in the menu is Select and the 6th is Move. With Move, drag something to a new place. Shortcut: hold your finger on it for 5 seconds and drag when the ring fills.
Text box
Write with the text button. While the text is selected, drag the handles on the box\'s edge to make the box bigger.
Background
Choose the paper\'s color, pattern or picture. If you picked a picture, set its place and size with Move / resize.
Ruler and shape template
Tap the Ruler button. Draw along the ruler\'s edge for a perfectly straight line, then tap Finish. With the Shape template button, pick a shape and trace its edge to copy it.
Save
Save your picture. You can choose CMYK for printing and set the folder with Choose location.
Text
Write titles and notes with the text button. While the text is selected, make its box bigger with the handles on the edge.
Pen
Write and draw by hand with the brush button.
Diagram
Add a ready-made diagram with the diagram button. You can choose it with or without a background (transparent).
Ruler
Open the ruler with the Ruler button, draw a straight line along its edge, then tap Finish.
Hold to move
To move something, hold your finger on it for 5 seconds. When the ring fills, drag.
Pages
Add pages and switch between them with the bar at the bottom. Long-press the bar and slide to flip through pages quickly.
Save as PDF
Turn your notes into a PDF from the ⋮ menu. In Page settings you can add page numbers, a header and a footer, and you can pick the folder when saving.
Ruler
Tap the Ruler button: if you draw along the ruler\'s edge, your line comes out super straight! Press Finish when you\'re done.
Drawing Quest
The trophy button has the Drawing Quest: 50 whole levels! Draw a picture on each level and collect the stars.
Finally, some green grass! Our picture is ready. If you want to see me again, tap my face in the corner. Now it\'s your turn!
I\'ve got news!
Hello again! I\'m going to show you some new things. Let\'s go!
Move a picture
To move a picture, hold your finger on it for 5 seconds. When the ring fills, slide your finger!
